messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(These are the federal holidays that either fall on a weekday or are observed on a weekday, creating a weekend that stretches over at least one Saturday or Sunday.)

| Long Weekend | Holiday(s) | Dates Covered | Notes |
|--------------|------------|---------------|-------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day (observed) | **Jan 1 – Jan 2** | Jan 1 2023 was a Sunday; the holiday is observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday | **Apr 7 – Apr 8** | Good Friday is always a Friday; the weekend extends to Saturday. |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | **May 20 – May 22** | Victoria Day is celebrated on the Monday before May 25. |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day (observed) | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Jul 1 2023 fell on a Saturday; the holiday is observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Labour Day is always on the first Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Thanksgiving is always on the second Monday in October. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Remembrance Day (observed) | **Nov 10 – Nov 11** | Nov 11 2023 was a Saturday; the holiday is observed on Friday Nov 10. |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Christmas Day is always on a Monday in 2023. |
| **Boxing Day** | Boxing Day | **Dec 24 – Dec 26** | Boxing Day is always on a Tuesday in 2023, giving a three‑day stretch (Sat‑Tue). |

> **Pro‑Provincial Variations**  
> Some provinces observe additional holidays that create long weekends, such as Family Day (Feb 20 in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) and St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17 in Newfoundland & Labrador). If you’re targeting a specific province, you’ll want to add those dates to the list above.

---

### How to Pull This Data Programmatically

If you’d like to pull this list into your holiday‑planning app automatically, you can use the popular `holidays` Python package:

```python
import holidays

canada_holidays = holidays.Canada(years=2023)
for date, name in sorted(canada_holidays.items()):
    print(date, name)
```

This will give you a dictionary of all federal holidays for 2023, which you can then filter for those that fall on a weekday or are observed on a weekday to identify long weekends.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown for a particular province or if you need help integrating this into your app!
